what: A ledger's traded_value must equal the sum of qty * price over all trades, within an absolute tolerance of 0.01.
why: Example second rule. Motivated by eval/ledgers/variant-04-control-first.json, which reports traded_value 906 while its trades sum to 905.
scope: Synthetic backtest ledgers; checks the top-level traded_value only.
implementation: Second Strike custom record. Status draft: not approved by a human, so the gate does not enforce it (state inactive -> not_enforced) until a human sets status active.
